planets.name: TOI-269 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-269 with a 3.7-day year, found in 2021.

text.card: TOI-269 b was found in 2021 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-269. Its orbit and size follow Cointepas et al. 2021's fit, the archive's default.
